deadline.value: No deadline for international applicants is stated. The 2027 international scholarship round closed on 15 September 2026; applications can be submitted at any time.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Admission requires an identified supervisor; UWA calls securing supervision an essential part of admission.
supervisor.quote: Identifying and securing academic supervision is an essential component for admission.

funding.value: UWA research scholarships are awarded through a competitive, merit-based selection process.
funding.quote: At UWA we award research scholarships through a competitive merit-based selection process

entry_route.value: UWA requires adequate research preparation; the fetched pages do not say whether a bachelor's degree alone is enough.

notes: The school page points to the HDR portal project list for PhD projects, and the PhD course page lists biological chemistry projects. No chemistry-specific admission rules were found.
